response.justification: Bogdan has strong experience in software development, distributed systems, and leadership (e.g., organizing workshops, mentoring, and founding projects), but his background leans heavily toward web/mobile development and Dlang rather than C++. His C++ experience is limited to early career roles (e.g., National Instruments) and lacks recent or high-scale infrastructure work. Cloud architecture and DevOps leadership are also underrepresented.
strengths: Strong leadership and mentorship experience (e.g., workshops, Selenium course, Refactoring Dojos).
Diverse technical experience across web, mobile, embedded systems, and distributed systems.
Proven ability to build and scale projects (e.g., GISCollective, Green Map application).
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (only early-career role) and no clear evidence of 8+ years in C++.
Lacks direct production-level cloud architecture or DevOps leadership experience.
No explicit experience managing large-scale compute infrastructure or hardware architecture.
